_readme: FIAT RUN EVENTS, THE TEST (BUILD46-E, 2 Nov): 4 jobs, $0.32 - a lean dog standing, the Estate's rival crew standing, the Town's person on the ground, a safe shut. Judge these in the fight's scene before the set.
Run: tools\art.bat run_events_test (the dry run first, then it asks).
Every job is generate-image-v2 at 65k px or under: $0.08 a job (docs/art/pixellab_lessons.md).
event_prop.gd finds each by name (art/events/<name>.png) and draws the slice's shapes where one isn't on disk.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_run_events_manifest.py; check with python3 tools/art_lint.py.

jobs.description: A different person from the reference image, in the same pose and framing: a scavenger from a rival estate crew: a plain red zip-up tracksuit top done up to the chin, a plain grey beanie, a bright yellow cloth tied round one arm as the crew's mark, plain cargo trousers, a crowbar through the belt, a sawn-off shotgun, standing ready, weapon held low across the body. One person alone, full body head to feet, facing the viewer, centred, filling the frame top to bottom, plain dark neutral background. Realistic painted pixel art, soft overcast light, muted cool northern palette, worn and lived-in, post-collapse Britain on a grey day; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not glossy; no text, no logos, no lettering, badges or numbers on anything.
